name: Concealing Distraction Discipline
description: Briefly erodes onlookers' attention with a gentle rush of Essence: until scene's end, all attempts to spot him are at +permanent Essence difficulty. Applies only while he draws no undue attention and stays unnoticed; once spotted the Charm ends and cannot be reactivated until he moves entirely out of sight.

name: Encounter-Banishing Gesture
description: Rips the memory of an encounter from a target's mind so he forgets he ever saw the Exalt: roll Manipulation + Stealth vs the target's Essence; each success erases one turn of memory (four successes erase four turns). A befuddled target won't notice him again for a like number of turns. No effect on higher-Essence beings or those physically agitated (e.g. in combat).

name: Splinter in the Mind's Eye
description: Duplicates Encounter-Banishing Gesture but its effects extend to a number of witnesses equal to permanent Essence×10 without requiring motes for each observer.

name: Unseen Wisp Method
description: Vanishes wholly from sight, dissolving in scattering shadows: for a number of turns equal to half the motes invested she is visible as no more than a wavering in the air. Ranged attacks against her are all but impossible without magic or well-described stunts; close attacks suffer a difficulty penalty of permanent Essence.

name: Noiseless Phantom Style
description: Enveloped in the stillness of the grave, she makes no noise whatsoever — footsteps, jumps, even shouts are silent. Conversely, she cannot speak or use any sound-based magic. Only wards sounds she makes: her blade sliding into ribs is silent, but the victim's scream is not.

name: Stifled Cry Exercise
description: Focuses on a single victim in line of sight and smothers his voice with Essence: until turn's end the target cannot speak or make any vocalized noise. Day Caste assassins use it to keep victims from screaming. No effect on higher-Essence beings.

name: Shadow Cloak Technique
description: Cocoons himself in pure darkness as a solidified shadow: so long as he stays in darkness or among shadows, adds 1 die per 2 motes to all Stealth rolls (not more than twice permanent Essence). If bright light is shined on him, the cloak dissolves immediately and the Charm ends.
